meta.description: Levers of the 'Balance the budget yourself' simulator (file 20 §5.3 after the 15-18 sync), multiplier classes (file 17 §8), toggles and anti-double-counting rules. Sign: positive = improves the balance.
meta.conventions: Decimal points and no thousands separators in JSON numbers; French formatting (comma decimal, narrow no-break space) is applied at render time. EUR bn = billions of euros, current prices. Every share says % of GDP or % of total public expenditure.

sign_convention: Positive EUR bn = improves the public balance; negative = worsens it.
